thread:
maria: Quick sync — we need a focused copy pass for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing pages ahead of next week's benchmark posts + webinar. Primary asks: align hero lines + CTAs per mode, two launch-post narratives, and the webinar landing. Can we get draft copy by Mon?

jake: Quick q — who exactly are we writing to for each mode? wanna tailor voice.

sunita: Hosted = devs/PLG builders. Dedicated = platform/SRE/infra owners. Private = security/compliance & legal. Tone: Hosted = fast + playful, Dedicated = operational reliability, Private = security-first and enterprise.

lia: Great — I'll mock 3 hero visual directions (one per mode) and two CTA variants: lightweight "Get started" vs intent-heavy "Talk to sales / Book a private demo".

oliver: For launch posts I recommend 2 narratives per mode: 1) benchmark story (latency/cost numbers, simple charts) and 2) operational story (how a customer moved from prototype -> production using our routing/fallbacks). Webinar = technical deep dive + live Q&A. Posts should gate the benchmark PDF and drive webinar signups.

maria: Inbound routing plan: self-serve signups (hosted) -> automatic onboarding flow; Dedicated inquiries -> SDR queue; Private -> AE + security solutions team. Add a hidden form field 'mode_interest' and UTMs so we can route.

jake: I'll draft three hero copy options per page. quick samples: Hosted: `Start building with a production-grade LLM API — minutes to first token.` Dedicated: `Reserved GPU capacity, predictable throughput for critical apps.` Private: `Run inference behind your VPC with enterprise controls.` Keep them short and test CTA variants.

sunita: Benchmarks need a methodology appendix. Call out test harness (sequence length, batching, quantization), hardware matrix, and what fallback routing we used. Transparency matters.

lia: Design notes — Dedicated hero should visually hint at throughput (rack/GPU iconography), Private gets compliance badges + lock motif, Hosted keeps product screenshots and quickstart CTA. I'll add alt-hero with product toggles to highlight routing.

oliver: Copy for launch posts: keep first paragraph benefit-led, second paragraph links to benchmark highlights (numbers), third paragraph CTA (download + webinar). Social snippets: emphasize cost/latency delta vs public baselines.

maria: Timeline proposal: copy drafts by Mon EOD, design comps Tue, assets + tracking (forms/UTM) Wed, publish posts Thu, webinar next Tue. Is that realistic?

jake: tight but doable if we focus on lean copy. I'll put timeblocks on Mon/Tue.

sunita: I'll own the benchmark appendix + data checks. Need dev/infra to confirm kernel/quant config used.

lia: I'll deliver desktop + mobile hero comps Tue noon. will also export social image sizes.

oliver: Growth will wire the webinar funnel and registration page. Recommend using a short qualifying form with segment radio (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) and a checkbox for "interested in dedicated pricing".

maria: Routing matrix: Hosted -> Product onboarding (auto emails), Dedicated -> SDR (HubSpot lead score 40+), Private -> AE + security intake (manual). Jake + Oliver, add hidden field `mode_interest` to all forms.

jake: noted. I'll add UTM templates and share form snippets: `<input type="hidden" name="mode_interest" value="hosted">` etc.

oliver: Also let's A/B subject lines for the launch email: A) "New benchmarks: cut token cost without sacrificing latency" B) "How teams are shipping low-latency LLM features in production".

sunita: Agree on A/B. Also: call out rollout plan in the post so platform customers know when Dedicated capacity slots open.

maria: Perfect. Final asks: Jake — first copy pass (three pages + post blurbs); Sunita — benchmark appendix; Lia — hero comps and social images; Oliver — webinar page + lead routing; I'll coordinate publish calendar and PR/social copy.

deploy-bot: Event created: "Redwood Platform Launch Webinar — Serving Modes Deep Dive" on Tue, link: https://calendar.company/evt/3123456 — invites sent to marketing, growth, eng-rep.

lia: :thumbsup: will add design comments in Figma.

maria: thanks team — I'll compile a single brief and drop it in #marketing-assets by EOD.

oliver: moving to action — adding checklist in Growth board.

jake: starting copy now, ping me if you want more aggressive hooks for hosted posts.

sunita: adding methodology draft to the thread in the morning.

maria: great — closing this sync, will follow up with the brief. :rocket:
